reviews.text:
One of my favorites!!

I like to try cushions, i bought this because the looks but turn of of the best i tried!! 
Isn't matte, but more like semi matte with a little of glow, so my dry skin can use it... 
the shade was perfect for me... not too bright.
So i'm happy with it, probabbly i'll buy it again!!

Comes with a refill and cute stickers :3
reviews.zh: 我嘅最愛之一！！鍾意試吓唔同嘅氣墊，本來只係因為個樣靚先買，點知變咗我用過最好嘅其中一盒！唔算霧面，反而係semi matte帶少少光澤，所以乾性肌都用得…色號對我嚟講好啱…唔會太白。所以我好滿意，應該會再買！！仲附送補充裝同埋得意貼紙:3

reviews.text: The packaging is adorable and it looks gorgeous from about 3 feet away. I’m still learning how to use it as it’s very different from other foundations and cushions I’ve used. It creases under eyes and you definitely need a powder but if you use too much it emphasizes texture. It has to be used in very thin layers with very little powder.
reviews.zh: 包裝好得意，望落大約3呎距離都覺得好靚。我仲學緊點用，因為同其他粉底同氣墊好唔同。眼底下會卡紋，一定需要碎粉，但用太多又會凸顯膚理。一定要好薄好薄咁上，碎粉都唔可以多。

reviews.text: Truthfully I bought this product because Sunghoon of Enhypen is the newest ambassador. I love the blue packaging and the overall quality of the cushion case. Its quite sleek! It is bigger than I thought, but it is still a convenient size to bring along with me. The pouch and stickers are my favorite part and I am super excited to decorate it. Featured is the kakao maltese dog which is one of my favorite dolls that engenes associate to Sunghoon. (stream XO (only if you say yes)!!!!)
reviews.zh: 老實講，我買呢個產品係因為 Enhypen 嘅 Sunghoon 係最新嘅代言人。我好鍾意佢藍色嘅包裝同埋氣墊盒嘅整體質素。好簡約！佢比我想像中大，但依然係一個方便攜帶嘅尺寸。收納袋同貼紙係我最鍾意嘅部分，我超級期待去裝飾佢。圖中係 kakao 嘅馬爾濟斯狗，係 engenes 會同 Sunghoon 聯想埋一齊嘅我最鍾意嘅公仔之一。（去聽 XO 啦（只限你話好嘅話）!!!!）

reviews.text: I got 21 ivory which is perfect for me although it is a bit too light if I use a lot for rn since it’s the summer but when it’s the winter I’m pretty sure it’ll match just fine! It came with a refill which is the 2nd one the 3rd one (mini) was a free gift! It also came with the clear bag and puffy stickers !! (In the box) also stream XO!
reviews.zh: 我揀咗 21 ivory，雖然而家夏天用多咗會有少少太白，但對我嚟講已經幾啱，但我好肯定到冬天嘅時候就會啱晒！佢附帶咗一個補充裝，係第二個，第三個（細裝）係免費禮物！仲送埋透明袋同立體貼紙！！（喺盒入面）仲有記得去聽 XO！

reviews.text: I have oily skin and I’m usually a shade 23 in korean cushions. I tried this cushion out because it’s more of a semi-matte finish which I did find it to be. It didn’t leave me looking oily or too shiny. There was a bit of a glow to it, but not too much. I did find that it does separate on my skin, but adding on a extra layer of moisturizer before it, does help. It also gets in those lines, for me it was between my eyebrows but it wasn’t too much. The cushion is very soft. I haven’t used such a soft cushion. I think this had more of a light-medium coverage but can cover acne if you put on more product. Personally, the shade was a bit lighter but maybe it’s because it’s already summer. It also found it to not last the whole day for me on hot days. I’ll give it another try during fall and hope it works out.
reviews.zh: 我係油性肌，韓妝氣墊通常用 23 色號。我試咗呢個氣墊，係因為佢比較偏向半霧面妝效，試完確實係咁。佢冇令我望落成面油或者太閃。會有少少光澤，但唔算多。我發現佢喺我塊面會有少少斑駁，不過喺用之前加多一層保濕霜會有幫助。佢都會卡入細紋，對我嚟講係眉心之間，但都唔算太嚴重。個氣墊好軟。我從來未用過咁軟嘅氣墊。我覺得呢個係輕至中度遮瑕，但如果用多啲可以遮到暗瘡。對我嚟講色號有少少太淺，但可能係因為已經係夏天。熱嘅日子都撐唔到成日。秋天會再試多次，希望夾返。

reviews.text: I feel like I found the holy grail cushion foundation that I was looking for!! I've tried clio, javin, espoir, and amuse but they never really gave me the perfect skin look with a natural finish like this one. I find this a perfect in-between javin and espoir without making the skin look cakey while covering flaws (pores, acne, sunspots). I chose No. 17 Porcelain for my usual #21-22 as recommended by YouTubers saying go one shade lighter since it does oxidize. I find #17 blends in with my skin well without looking orangey or "off" after it oxidizes. It does last long but I don't think it is completely waterproof alone. I recommend using a setting spray to make it last longer. Overall, this really does make my skin look flawless, and will definitely come back for more.
reviews.zh: 我覺得我搵到我一直喺搵嘅完美氣墊粉底！！我試過 clio、javin、espoir 同 amuse，但都冇一個俾到我好似呢個咁自然嘅完美妝感。我覺得呢個係 javin 同 espoir 之間嘅完美平衡，遮住瑕疵（毛孔、暗瘡、曬斑）之餘又唔會令皮膚望落厚重。我揀咗 No. 17 Porcelain 取代我平時用嘅 #21-22，因為 YouTuber 建議揀淺一個色號，等氧化之後就啱。氧化之後我覺得 #17 同我塊面融為一體，唔會變橙或者「怪色」。佢確實持久，但單用嘅話我覺得唔算完全防水。建議用定妝噴霧令佢持久啲。整體嚟講，佢真係令我塊面睇落完美，一定會再回購。

reviews.text: The crazy hype on this product on YouTube and instagram led me to buy it. I'm usually shade 21 for cushion, I did my research and got 17 porcelain. I'm glad I did because the shade fits me quite well. I think 21 ivory would've been too dark on me. I would say this is more of a semi-matte cushion which I usually prefer to use in summer. I like it so far. There's slight bit of darkening after 4+ hrs
reviews.zh: YouTube 同 Instagram 對呢個產品嘅瘋狂熱度令我入手。我平時用氣墊 21 色號，做完功課之後揀咗 17 porcelain。好慶幸咁揀，因為色號幾夾我。我覺得 21 ivory 對我嚟講會太深。我會形容呢個係半霧面氣墊，夏天我通常會揀呢類。到而家為止我都幾鍾意。4 個鐘之後會有少少變暗。

reviews.text: Your skin but semi matte🫰🏻I know it’s long lasting and smudge proof bc I hit the fridge door at work then I rush to check my face, and woww it’s not budge at all! Anyway yeah I own both version of this cushion and love both of them. Felt comfy on my skin and the shade fit light medium SEA girl🥳 I’m glad I give this brand a try. Did not come with refill:(
reviews.zh: 你嘅皮膚但係半霧面🫰🏻我知道佢持久同防暈染，因為我喺公司撞到雪櫃門，返去睇塊面，嘩一啲都冇甩！總之我兩版都買咗，兩版都鍾意。喺塊面上面好舒服，色號啱晒中等膚色嘅東南亞女仔🥳好慶幸試咗呢個品牌。冇附帶補充包:(

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
